recipes.title: Spicy Red Lentil & Spinach Dahl
recipes.ingredients:
500g Red Lentils
400g Brown Rice
3 Onions
Garlic
Fresh Spinach
2 Cans Diced Tomatoes
Rapeseed Oil
Curry powder, turmeric, cumin, chili flakes
recipes.instructions:
1. Cook brown rice.
2. Sauté onions and garlic.
3. Add spices.
4. Add lentils, tomatoes, water.
5. Simmer 30 mins.
6. Add spinach and serve.

recipes.title: Lean Chicken, Bean & Corn Chili
recipes.ingredients:
500g Chicken Breast
3 Cans Kidney Beans
400g Brown Rice
2 Red Peppers
2 Onions
2 Cans Sweet Corn
3 Cans Diced Tomatoes
recipes.instructions:
1. Cook rice.
2. Brown chicken.
3. Add veg.
4. Add beans, corn, tomatoes.
5. Simmer 25 mins.
6. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Flaxseed & Walnut N'oats
recipes.ingredients:
30g Ground Flaxseed
20g Walnuts
100ml Almond Milk
Cinnamon
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix flax and milk.
2. Heat gently.
3. Stir until thick.
4. Add walnuts and serve.

recipes.title: Chocolate Brownies
recipes.ingredients:
150g Dark Choc
100g Butter
100g Erythritol
50g Almond Flour
recipes.instructions:
1. Melt chocolate and butter.
2. Mix ingredients.
3. Bake 20 mins.
4. Cool and slice.
